technical.summary: Oversold technicals with early stochrsi recovery and bullish OBV divergence show potential, but price remains below all key moving averages with bearish MACD and weak money flow—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

sentiment.summary: Market fear (31 VIX-equivalent) presents contrarian opportunity, but mixed congressional activity and absent news data limit conviction; neutral to slightly bearish setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (327.36) with imminent CPI event and negative macro score (-3) create severe near-term headwinds; 75-day earnings window adds moderate binary risk.
